name: Hip-hop and trap
description: A hip-hop or trap song: hooks around two 16-bar verses. 64 bars.

sections.name: Intro
sections.tip: A few bars of the melody or the beat, before the drums come in.

sections.name: Hook
sections.tip: The part everyone remembers: short and repeatable, over the full beat.

sections.name: Verse
sections.tip: Room for the rapper: a steady beat with space in the mix for the voice.

sections.name: Verse
sections.tip: Switch up the drums, or drop the beat out for a bar, to keep the second verse moving.

sections.name: Hook
sections.tip: The last hook, maybe with an extra layer or ad-libs.

sections.name: Outro
sections.tip: End on the melody, or let the beat ride out.
